about_the_game:
When shadows of the past cast upon the present, your choices will change destiny.

In the river of time, every soul carries connections from past lives. Across a thousand years, the threads of fate and unsolved royal secrets await you.

The story of Ha Dong-hoon, Korea's top photographer, now traces back to its origins. "Trilogy of the Moon - The First Fate" DLC is a prequel that explores the hidden secrets between Baran Kingdom's 4th King Hadou and his consorts, content that predates the events of "Trilogy of the Moon." Through the story of two royal consorts reincarnated in modern times, the intimate royal scandals of Baran Kingdom from a millennium ago will be revealed.

Story

A royal curse spanning a thousand years!

Ha Dong-hoon, Korea's premier photographer, has earned fame with his exceptional talent, but lives in loneliness due to psychological barriers that emerge in moments of love. At a modeling contest, he meets rival models Kang Sua and Lee Haeun, and begins to see strange visions. Through an ancestral spirit appearing in his dreams, he discovers the shocking truth: he is the reincarnation of Baran Kingdom's 4th King Hadou, and the two models are reincarnations of his royal consorts. Can he unravel the curse and secrets from his past life to find happiness in the present?

Character Introduction

Kang Sua - The reincarnation of a beloved royal consort who hides a bold nature behind her elegant and feminine appearance.

Lee Haeun -  The reincarnation of a strong royal consort who kept the secrets of Baran Kingdom's court, with a bold personality contrasting her cute appearance.

Product Features

· An immersive interactive game with first-person perspective high-definition full-motion video.

· Multiple choices and endings with storylines that evolve based on player decisions.

· Vivid performances by skilled models recreating both ancient Baran Kingdom's court and modern photoshoot settings.

· Various achievements and special image rewards available throughout gameplay.

· Enriched romance and mystery with bonus videos and still images of the actors.

A Fateful Encounter Transcending Time

This DLC offers an opportunity to delve deeper into the world of "Trilogy of the Moon." A story of thousand-year secrets, curses, and reincarnated connections will guide players into a world of romance that transcends time. Your choices create a special story – start now!

content_descriptors.notes: Game contains sensitive contents such as partial nudity or sexual content, as well as alcohol use, may not be suitable for all age ranges.
